selection: 4 visual cells per each of 8 named types ranked by direct DN contacts; union of top 2 DN targets per type, filled to 16 by contact rank; top 32 two-hop bridge cells by minimum incoming/outgoing contact strength; all measured internal directed edges retained. Ties by body ID. No game outcomes used.
assumptions: Engineered 8-channel input injection; simplified signed, normalized, leaky tanh rate units. Acetylcholine +1, GABA/glutamate -1; unknown and modulatory transmitters 0. Not a physiological or whole-brain model.
